_doc: Training-split sizes used by the mixing calculator. The paper does not list them; these are the TensorFlow Datasets catalog counts (fetched 2026-10-02) for the data sets the paper names, which it says all came from TFDS (§2.3). WSC keeps only its True examples (about half of 554, §2.4) and DPR adds about 1,000 (§2.4): both approximate. WNLI is never trained on (§2.4). C4 is the unsupervised task; its count is c4/en train documents.
